We need to produce JSON with summary (<=80 words), next_steps (3 strings), criteria object mapping criterion id to feedback <=70 words each. Address student as "you". Be specific, supportive, actionable, cite sections/figures, name what they did well, state what next rubric level requires. Don't change marks. Don't comment on conversion artefacts. Don't make up explanations for unclear reasoning.

We have criteria C1-C7 with marks. Need feedback for each. Summary overall. Next steps 3.

C1: Proficient 4/6. Feedback: You chose performance and availability well, grounded in 900 orders and 4.2s p95. Performance scenario complete and measurable. Availability scenario has six parts but "stay up most of the time" isn't measurable and response drifts from order-placement artefact. To reach Excellent, make both response measures measurable and align availability response with order service. <=70 words.

C2: Excellent 6/6. Feedback: Strong modular monolith recommendation with scenario-specific trade-offs (five developers vs infra overhead; known problems from single VM/deployment not monolith shape) and explicit downside. Excellent level met. Keep linking trade-offs to scenario evidence. <=70.

C3: Proficient 5/8. Feedback: (a) 99.30% and (b) 5.0 hours correct with working. In (c) you correctly combined payment to 0.999975 but never recombined with other three components; end-to-end should be 99.80% and ~1.5 hours downtime, not 99.9975%/0.018h. To reach Excellent, recompute full series and carry rounding to two decimals. <=70.

C4: Excellent 5/5. Feedback: Circuit breaker named, Closed/Open/Half-Open mechanism explained with failure counting/timeouts, applied to 25-minute outage with user-visible fallback, and tuning consideration (threshold/window). Excellent. Keep concrete application. <=70.

C5: Proficient 4/6. Feedback: Both choices sensible with concrete techniques (Redis TTL, idempotency keys). CAP explanation is wrong: you cannot give up partition tolerance and keep both C and A; during a partition you choose C or A. To reach Excellent, correct CAP framing and tie each choice to partition behaviour. <=70.

C6: Proficient 4/5. Feedback: Context, Decision, Consequences present and specific (offline tablet, synchronous call, 4.2s p95, RabbitMQ, retrying worker). Consequences are all positive; no negative consequence. To reach Excellent, add at least one negative consequence (e.g., duplicate notifications, eventual consistency for outlets, queue ops burden). <=70.

C7: Proficient 3/4. Feedback: Writing clear, headings and IEEE-style references present; Q1, Q4, Q5, Q6 within 150 words. Q2 ~195 words exceeds limit. To reach Excellent, bring every answer within 150 words and keep citations precise. <=70.
